status: Strict-functor wrapper/name retirement complete in the final staged LP. Production promotion and the other explicit goal gates remain open.
contracts: Remove the 39 inventoried legacy declarations and all active references to their names in final emitted LP outputs. Historical and intermediate authoring sources retain old spellings solely to replay the pre-goal source.

Functor/Functor_cat and ordinary maps/constructors replace the strict-object classifier, carrier views, admission wrappers, full-subcategory inclusion and named strict identity/constant/Path/profunctor maps.
Existing generic DefIso, ordinary isomorphism-evidence and Prof-comparison owners replace strict-prefixed adapters. The original selected inverses and cancellation computations are retained.

The existing equivalence-mapping implementation is renamed omega_equiv_along_fmap with corresponding law/projection names, preserving both chosen inverses. The different omega_equiv_along_fapp1 homwise-equivalence operation is unchanged.
Coevaluation/evaluation implementations move directly into their existing public _func owners. Whole curry/uncurry, their chosen inverse and retained beta/eta evidence are preserved.

IsStrictFunctor and compositor-evidence projections remain descriptive native property/proof interfaces. functor_is_strict supplies the canonical proof for every default map; no operational map requires admission evidence.
StrictTransfor, StrictFunctord and the separate LaxTransfor Homs of GrayHom_lax remain. Ordinary functor object equality does not identify these higher categories.
No runtime or unification rule is added. Existing rule applications now refer directly to their ordinary operands/owners. Core and default Hom-accumulation source bytes are unchanged.

The original 2440 central assertions and 66 declarations remain, expressed through ordinary carriers where the wrapper interface was retired. Two temporary alias-only checks from the preceding transition are removed from its separate consumer driver.
